reason.description: Why the run was reverted, failed or postponed; empty otherwise

drain_timeout_s.description: How long contract and abort wait for sessions to leave the schema version being dropped (default 30)

lock_budget_s.description: Total time the migration may spend waiting for locks before it is aborted (default 10)

lock_timeout_ms.description: lock_timeout for every migration statement; a statement that cannot get its lock gives up and retries (default 1000)

max_lock_wait_ms.description: Abort if an application session is blocked by the migration for longer than this (default 3000)

max_rollbacks_per_s.description: Abort if rolled-back transactions per second exceed the pre-migration baseline by more than this (default 20)

throttle_ratio.description: Pause this many times the duration of the last batch, so a slower database gets a slower backfill (default 0.5)

blocks.description: What that lock blocks, and for how long

lock.description: Strongest table lock the step takes

info.description: Drives pgroll migrations through expand, verify and contract under live load, and reverts them when locks or errors exceed their thresholds. Reads need the viewer or operator token, everything else the operator token, as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents.
